profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tranche 2 Tracking Layer — Space Development Agency
 
Contributed to SDA's Tranche 2 Tracking Layer, expanding the constellation's ability to detect, track, and target advanced missile threats, including  systems from space. My role focused on mission planning, building cloud-based infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes to support mission execution, data processing, and coordination across the tracking system.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to SDA's Tracking Layer, a constellation designed to detect, track, and target advanced missile threats  including systems from space. My role focused on as Lead of spacecraft navigation and data science: developing mathematical algorithms and software to guide tracking behavior throughout a mission's execution, and analyzing sensor data to support the system's broader fusion and data-processing pipeline across orbital regimes.

positions.title: Data Analyst - Internship
positions.description: Making modification with gSuite integration to the digital assistance of Verizon employees chatbot, programming in java and creating a new algorithm  to solve problems of the service.

positions.title: Using VGo Robotic Telepresence Device to Provide an Effective Communication Setting for the Deaf
positions.description: According to this  research we are relating the standards of the  World  Health  Organization,  that they are  approximately  360  million  people worldwide  that  have  disabling  hearing  loss  and  70  million  that  are  mute.  Developing communication  advancements  is  very  complex  and  it’s  been  a  challenge  for  many  years. Currently sign language, which is expressed through the hands and face and perceived through the  eyes   is  the  standard  communication  method  for  people  with  hearing.  However, inventions over the pass years have been made with better communication mechanisms for the hearing impaired and it still a big challenge. There  exist  different  mechanisms  to  translate  sign  language  and  improve  communication between signers and no signers. The most common are the use of an interpreter, the use of written communication and more recently voice to text transcription, but each of these has disadvantages in terms of cost or availability of resources. We are interested to be able to provide a computerized sign¬ to ¬text alternative, which is able to analyze facial and body movements to convert sign expressions into text.

positions.title: Cyber Security
positions.description: This project sponsored by NSF REU program through TTU site. Is to study Industrial Internet of Things and implement a minimal-function testbed of IIoT. The testbed consists of sensor nodes, XBee modules, a gateway and a cloud server. In real world the sensors will need to be attached to machines like 3D printers. A list of basic functions (sensing, transmitting and displaying, etc.) have been implemented and tested individually. Real-time sensing data collection via wireless links and display on an open-source website have been successfully demonstrated, which can serve as a proof-of- concept test before scale up the system by adding different sensors and covering a wider area.
